gloss: intense heat; heat wave; sweltering weather

definitions.gloss: intense heat; heat wave; extremely hot weather
definitions.explanation: exceptionally hot summer weather, typically when temperatures exceed 35°C (95°F); used to describe periods of dangerous heat

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{猛暑|もうしょ}だ。
{猛暑|もうしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}えて→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please refrain from going outside due to the intense heat.

examples.japanese: {猛暑|もうしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}す→体調を崩す：16480_taichouwokuzusu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The continuing heat wave is causing more people to fall ill.

notes:
FORMS:
{猛|もう} (fierce, intense) + {暑|しょ} (heat) → fierce heat

JAPANESE WEATHER TERMINOLOGY:
- ⟦{猛暑日|もうしょび}→猛暑日：09622_moushobi⟧: day when maximum temperature reaches 35°C or above
- ⟦{真夏日|まなつび}→真夏日：10186_manatsubi⟧: day when maximum temperature reaches 30°C or above
- ⟦{熱帯夜|ねったいや}→熱帯夜：10187_nettaiya⟧: tropical night (minimum temperature stays above 25°C)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{酷暑|こくしょ}→酷暑：08324_kokusho⟧ (extreme/severe heat - even more intense)
- ⟦{炎暑|えんしょ}→炎暑：19813_ensho⟧ (scorching heat - literary)
- ⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧ (heat - general)
- ⟦{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}→熱中症：08330_necchuushou⟧ (heatstroke)

USAGE:
{猛暑|もうしょ} is commonly used in weather reports and news during summer months. It carries a warning nuance about dangerous heat conditions.
